entities.name: Agustín Cuzzani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Agustín Cuzzani was an Argentine dramatist, known for his satiric vision and criticism of capitalist society. He is famous for having created farsátira as a theatrical genre. His most famous and transcendental work is El centroforward murió al amanecer. In 1988 his collected plays were published as "Teatro Completo".
